digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge preview/sync CLI and reconcile command
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must run one ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit a single manifest containing the arbitrated plan plus exact field-level drift from that same pass, without launching or reimplementing reconcile-check.

Canonical bridge preview must be lock-free: it loads a coherent read-only snapshot without acquiring, purging, stealing, or writing the pass lock, while legacy reconcile-check remains independently lock-free through its existing diagnostic branch.

The argparse parser must set allow_abbrev=False so that abbreviated or unknown options (e.g., --dry-run) exit with invocation error 2 before any repository read, lock, or mutation; documented legacy options like --mode dry-run remain valid.

Canonical bridge preview and canonical bridge sync must emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope; canonical uncapped live must retain a manifest with exact applied/failed tally, while legacy uncapped LIVE callers through CLI/library/MCP retain the historical tally/no-retained-manifest contract.

Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check must retain its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact (bridge_state/reconcile-check.json), output, and exit behavior unchanged.

Existing capped canonical sync and legacy bootstrap applied/deferred partitions must remain unchanged; documentation must make bridge preview the primary dry-run guidance and explicitly preserve reconcile-check as a distinct diagnostic and legacy live-output behavior as historical.
